description: Time series for one activity, downsampled by Garmin to about `points` rows, for questions like "did my HR drift in the last 10 km?" or "where did my pace fade?". Returns `columns` and `rows`; each row starts with distance (km) and elapsed time (s). Default channels: hr, pace, grade_adjusted_pace, cadence, power, elevation; channels the activity didn't record are left out. Use speed instead of pace for cycling. Location is never returned. Get the activity id from garmin_search_activities.

channels.description: Channels to include. Default: hr, pace, grade_adjusted_pace, cadence, power, elevation.

name: garmin_get_activity_streams
title: Get Garmin activity streams
